name: events_destination
description: Path to an external program that receives event JSON via stdin. Set to enable event forwarding; unset to disable. Must be a fully-qualified executable path.

name: events_async
description: When TRUE, events are delivered fire-and-forget — DuckDB doesn't wait for the handler before returning from the originating query. Trades reliability for latency.

name: events_types
description: List of event types to capture. Available: 'connection_opened', 'connection_closed', 'query_begin', 'query_end', 'transaction_begin', 'transaction_commit', 'transaction_rollback'. Default: ['query_begin', 'query_end'].

name: events_session_name
description: Optional string included in every event. Useful for distinguishing events from multiple DuckDB processes feeding the same handler.
